title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 58c8e25de53f… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 58c8e25de53f0b4c9afee286556cc8d70d7a7f4900689ab09454640af01aa7cd was observed twice on November 2, 2026, by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. The file is associated with attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) and was seen originating from infrastructure in France. This hash corresponds to a specific malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check this hash against their environments and security tools to detect potential compromise.
